corrections.why: The FFLA list marks the Antrim Point site as gone, but the cab was moved to Lookout Mountain in 1974 and the sources say it stands there. The record should show the move.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts and the survey description give 1937 for the station and lookout site; firelookout.com gives 1939, when an L-4 cab was brought in from Dutch Hill. The story gives both.
Forest Lookouts dates the move of lookout duties to Lookout Mountain to 1973; NHLR and firelookout.com date the cab's move to 1974.
firelookout.com dates the R-6 cab replacement to 1968; NHLR and firelookout.com's Lookout Mountain page say the cab was built in 1969.

notes_for_editor: Status is the main issue: the record says gone for the point, but the cab was moved to Lookout Mountain (NHLR US 791, MT 48) in 1974 and sources say it stands there. The story covers both places; facts.status 'relocated' and the status correction need human review. Kind 'two_story' comes from the FFLA '2-Story cab' label; firelookout.com describes an L-4 cab, then an 8-foot R-6 flat cab, and does not say two-story, so the kind is unverified and left alone. The 1939 (firelookout.com) and 1937 (Forest Lookouts, USGS-era survey description) start dates conflict. The 1959 lookout is Dameaon Wilcox on firelookout.com and Damian Wilcox in the Ravalli Republic quote; the story does not name him. No source describes what remains at the original point today or whether the 1937 survey tablet survives. A separate record, us-mt-lookout-mountain-3 (Ravalli, status standing, coordinates matching the NHLR page), already covers the cab's current site; it may need a note pointing back here. Used two WebSearch calls. Fact-check 2026-10-10: removed the unsourced advice about not climbing Lookout Mountain; the NHLR page says only that the lookout is regularly staffed in fire season. Added quotes for the brass tablet and the July 1, 1946 date.
